last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription endometriosis self-management topics. The final query set returned 140 unique PubMed PMIDs, 140 fetched article records, and 137 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 37467936, 41717450, 35276031, 39110208, 39459464, 33428320, 40319391, 32453393, 33508990, 29264492, 23602498, 37267394, and 40844480. Fifteen PubMed references were added across 13 new entries. New entries cover supervised exercise, yoga, cognitive behavioral therapy, an internet pain-management program, mindfulness, acupuncture, a hydrotherapy-and-massage program, pelvic-floor physiotherapy, a low-FODMAP diet, omega-3, vitamin D, resveratrol, and melatonin. Acupressure, generic physiotherapy, heat therapy, TENS, gluten-free diet, Mediterranean diet, anti-inflammatory diet, curcumin, N-acetylcysteine, probiotics, ginger, magnesium, vitamin E, cannabis, patient education, and stress management were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect; the retained pelvic-floor trial was not generalized to generic physiotherapy. The sleep topic was represented only through melatonin trials that measured sleep quality. Five truthful thin-study warnings remain for the 31-person exercise trial, 35-person low-FODMAP trial, 44-person HAMMAM trial, 34-person pelvic-floor physiotherapy trial, and 44-person resveratrol trial, including the prior thin-study backlog.
